module.name: XRFlow Softphone Hub
module.description: Free GPLv3+ companion for XRFlow Softphone on this FreePBX or PBXact: one-button enroll, WebRTC repair, fleet hooks, and Company Presence detect. Desktop seats are a separate commercial product. This module is not sold and does not require a Hub license key. Does not rewrite System Admin OpenVPN remotes.

Desktop seats remain commercial. Sangoma GPG signing prep. *0.1.3* preinst probes PHP APIs (json_encode, curl_init, PDO mysql) — JSON is core in PHP 8, not php8.2-json *0.1.2* Debian Depends + preinst: refuse install unless FreePBX 17 and PHP curl/xml/mysql/mbstring are present *0.1.1* Enroll tokens (15 min, one-time) + POST /xrflow-hub/v1/enroll/redeem *0.1.0* Skeleton: license activate, 14-day trial, dashboard, REST 402 gate, WebRTC 488 checklist + template
